items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Charlie James, he was associated with the union down there at one time in Philadelphia, the negro union.

ctx.x: Yeah, I worked many gigs with Willie - I wonder if he's still living now. He'd be quite old though, I guess, for the game [?] -

Charlie James, he was associated with the union down there at one time in Philadelphia, the negro union. Yeah, that's another one, see how it comes to me, I can't, see - because I didn't work that long. You see, that's where, that's where you can get me mixed -
